playtest.entry: Playtest: production Main and actual renderer integration on assigned Linux X11, using only isolated synthetic profiles. No browser is involved in this native engine workflow.

steps.step: Render a roofed gallery with three RGB LEDs, textured stone/brick/plank surfaces and a water patch.
steps.expected: Visible lit geometry, shadows, sky/clouds, reflections, fog and emissive particles; no GL errors.
steps.observed: Passed on strict 3.3, modern compute/indirect path and 4x MSAA resolve. Native HDR gallery captures saved.

steps.step: Build a maximum-depth hierarchy from a synthetic occluder. Test rear bounds, one uncovered depth sample, changed view and invalidated world.
steps.expected: Reject only fully hidden stable bounds; keep uncertain or stale cases visible.

steps.step: Add a projected decal, capture a six-face probe, add water and remove LED sources.
steps.expected: Decal changes floor; complete local capture; reflected/refracted water changes pixels; GPU particles disappear after source removal.
steps.observed: Decal changed 44666 pixels on modern path; six faces completed; water assertion passed; 48 particles became 0.

steps.step: Move the camera with TAA enabled, enable auto exposure, lower input scale, force the timing controller under measured load and apply a warm LUT.
steps.expected: Finite adapted exposure; valid temporal history; output stays at display size; dynamic scale falls; LUT visibly changes pixels.
steps.observed: All native assertions passed, including the actual GPU timing controller.

steps.step: Use W, F10, F6 and Escape in production Main. Resize to 333x271 at input scale 0.65.
steps.expected: Camera moves, recording finishes, isometric mode switches, odd-size temporal resolve remains valid and the controls menu opens.
steps.observed: Passed; 40 clean production frames. Finished F10 clip has 8 differing frames, 8.297 seconds and 227240 bytes.

visualInspection: Inspected the fresh production gallery, decoded MP4 midpoint and modern water capture. They show the implemented gallery, RGB lights, texture detail, sky/clouds and water; no prompts, answers, credentials or account data are visible.
